findings.event: Analytics for Good Hackathon (Minneapolis); curator brief (single-institution events)
findings.summary: Ruling: t2/t3 were right to reject hackathons open only to one institution's students (verified on KTPHacks 2 and Grizzly Hacks VII; consistent with 8+ earlier rejections). The brief does not state this rule, and the oct31-d2 add Analytics for Good Hackathon breaks it: its organiser page says it is open only to University of Minnesota Twin Cities and Duluth students. That page also announces January 29-30, 2027, while the record still shows recurring-tbd.
findings.recommendation: Add to curator.md: an event open only to one institution's students or members is rejected as not publicly attendable, and Devpost 'Invite only' alone is not the test. Remove Analytics for Good Hackathon under that rule, or if it is kept, set next_date 2027-01-29, next_date_end 2027-01-30, status upcoming.
